channel.title: Canada Food System Observatory: weekly brief
channel.description: A weekly summary of official Canadian and global data on the food system. A research product, not an official warning service.

item.title: Weekly brief 2026-W46
item.description: Commercial elevators and port terminals held 7.25 million tonnes of grain in the week ending 4 October 2026. Higher than in any of the previous 5 years for this time of year (2% above the median). Worth a closer look; not by itself a sign of crisis.
